title: a0-Horizon Scale Identity
statement: a0 = xi * c * H0, with theoretical candidate xi = 1/(2*pi).

verification.quarantine_reason: Consistency at z=0 is an anchor consistency, not a theoretical derivation. The empirical measurement fails to distinguish the horizon formula from empirical MOND a0 at 3 sigma at z=0.

epistemic_boundary.closure_path: Measurement of a0(z) at high redshift (z ~ 1-3) via kinematic rotation curves when observational high-redshift data becomes available.
